strassenbrau.name: Straßenbräu
strassenbrau.highlight: A taproom with the second-best beer of the season (4.50), though there is no food, so eat first.

heidenpeters.name: Heidenpeters
heidenpeters.highlight: Open from noon on Saturdays with food and a solid beer score of 3.92, closing early at 20:00.

neulich.name: Neulich
neulich.highlight: Open until 03:00 on Saturdays with food and a 4.00 for atmosphere, a good place for a late stop.

brauhaussuedstern.name: Brauhaus Südstern
brauhaussuedstern.highlight: Brewery with food, open until 01:00 on Saturdays, but service can be slow so give it time.

schoppebrau.name: Schoppe Bräu
schoppebrau.highlight: A tiny taproom with the third-best atmosphere score (4.25) and just one couch table for 8 to 10 people.

berlinerberg.name: Berliner Berg
berlinerberg.highlight: Beer garden with Berliner Weisse, the top service score of the season (5.00), and you can bring your own food.

schalander.name: Schalander
schalander.highlight: In the RAW area with flammkuchen on the menu and a strong 4.33 for atmosphere.

hopsandbarley.name: Hops & Barley
hopsandbarley.highlight: Small taproom with the third-best beer of the season (4.40) and no food.

protokoll.name: Protokoll
protokoll.highlight: Small taproom serving four of its own beers, with no food on the menu.

georgbrau.name: Georgbräu
georgbrau.highlight: Brewery on the Spreeufer with food, open from noon to 22:00.

brauhausspandau.name: Brauhaus Spandau
brauhausspandau.highlight: Brewpub in Spandau with food from 11:00; we visited during the Christmas market, and it is best to book ahead.

eschenbrau.name: Eschenbräu
eschenbrau.highlight: Large brewery with pretzels and flammkuchen, open until 01:00; book about two weeks ahead.

vagabundkesselhaus.name: Vagabund Kesselhaus
vagabundkesselhaus.highlight: Brewery with food that stays open until 02:00 on Saturdays, with service as its best score (3.50).

circus.name: Circus
circus.highlight: Come for the Hoff museum and the one beer on tap; there is no food in the brewery.

schankhallepfefferberg.name: Schankhalle Pfefferberg
schankhallepfefferberg.highlight: Large brewpub with a beer garden, but it opens at 15:00 so there is no lunch.

marcusbrau.name: Marcus-Bräu
marcusbrau.highlight: Reasonable prices for normal food and good service (3.67), though opinions on the beer were split.

lemkehackeschermarkt.name: Lemke Hackescher Markt
lemkehackeschermarkt.highlight: Large Berliner Weisse brewery in the S-Bahn arches at Hackescher Markt, with a very good beer score of 4.14 but weaker service.

brlo.name: BRLO Brwhouse
brlo.highlight: Brewhouse with food, open from noon, and one of the better beers of the season (4.00); book ahead for groups.
